name: Stylus
description: One line and the point it started from.

code.style: --rule: ( --rot: @pick(0deg, 45deg, 90deg, 135deg, 180deg, 225deg, 270deg, 315deg); @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: @svg(viewBox: 0 0 100 100; path { d: M18 82 L82 18; fill: none; stroke: #000; stroke-width: 8; stroke-linecap: round; }); mask: @svg(viewBox: 0 0 100 100; path { d: M18 82 L82 18; fill: none; stroke: #000; stroke-width: 8; stroke-linecap: round; }); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: @svg(viewBox: 0 0 100 100; path { d: M18 82 A2 2 0 1 1 17.9 82; fill: none; stroke: #000; stroke-width: 16; stroke-linecap: round; }); mask: @svg(viewBox: 0 0 100 100; path { d: M18 82 A2 2 0 1 1 17.9 82; fill: none; stroke: #000; stroke-width: 16; stroke-linecap: round; }); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } -webkit-transform: rotate(@var(--rot)); transform: rotate(@var(--rot)); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
